speaker: KID
spoken_text: OHHH! No-look catch! That's aura farming!

speaker: TYLER
spoken_text: What the fuck is wrong with this dude?

speaker: TYLER
spoken_text: This is Elijah. He doesn't try. At anything.

speaker: TYLER
spoken_text: And the whole school treats him like a final boss.

speaker: TYLER
spoken_text: He leans his way to class. Poles. Doors. One time, the principal.

speaker: KAYLA
spoken_text: He's aura farming. I have it on video.

speaker: TYLER
spoken_text: I've farmed aura for years. Zero crops.

speaker: TYLER
spoken_text: Second period. Band. Elijah plays the triangle.

speaker: TYLER
spoken_text: One ding. The whole band stops.

speaker: MR_HAYES
spoken_text: Elijah. That was perfect. Tyler, less tuba.

speaker: TYLER
spoken_text: I played tuba for forty minutes. Nobody turned around.

speaker: TYLER
spoken_text: His sheet music was upside down. Still perfect.

speaker: TYLER
spoken_text: Art class. We paint each other.

speaker: TYLER
spoken_text: Elijah paints me in one line. Then I look closer.

speaker: TYLER
spoken_text: It's the coat rack.

speaker: KAYLA
spoken_text: Bro. He can't see.

speaker: TYLER
spoken_text: The no-look catch. The triangle. He wasn't farming anything.

speaker: TYLER
spoken_text: After school. I point at his head. Glasses. All day.

speaker: ELIJAH
spoken_text: Wait. Why is everyone LOOKING at me?!

speaker: TYLER
spoken_text: He backs into me. My sandwich rolls under the bus.

speaker: TYLER
spoken_text: Elijah got his glasses. Kayla got two million views. The bus got my sandwich.
